name: p2e
description: P2E authoring + workflow commands for Claude Code (also ships Codex skills and a Cursor `.cursor/` surface — same shared workflows on all three). Adds /p2e-bootstrap, /p2e-add-story, /p2e-update-story, /p2e-work-on-next, /p2e-sync-labels, /p2e-sync, /p2e-bind, /p2e-manage-uxo, /p2e-archaeology, /p2e-fix, /p2e-html, /p2e-md, and /p2e-md-to-html, plus the writing-rich-html-docs skill for opinionated rich-HTML doc rendering. Aligned with the P2E Patton v3 Flow/Foundation model (flows + products MCP tools, Story.priority queue). Backed by the p2e MCP. Use /p2e-bind once per repo to anchor it to a P2E project for automatic slug calibration.
